definitions.full: H1407. gad I. גַּד noun masculine coriander (Late Hebrew גִּיד , Aramaic גִּידָּא ; connection with above √ dubious; see further Löw No. 155 ) — גַּד זֶרַע Exod 16:31 ; Num 11:7 , simile of manna.

occurrences.englishText: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”,† “Manna” means “What is it?” and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.† Bdellium is a resin extracted from certain African trees.
